comparison_rules: Recursive equality of every field except execution timestamps (executed_at,executed_at_utc,time_utc) and duplicate historical stdout; actual root path normalized to {ROOT}. All retained structured scientific values, input/source hashes, ranks, fitted rates, entropy bounds, seeds, statuses and numerical diagnostics compared.
environment_limitation: Reused the same installed Python environment and cached Tectonic bundle; no new platform or dependency installation was tested. Final archive is regenerated after receipt/document updates; all scientific code, TeX, bibliography and PDFs remain the replayed bytes.
